# Lily Alan
# https://lilyalan.com/

> Lily Alan is an advanced clinical hypnotherapist and coach helping women over 40 with anxiety, people pleasing, emotional exhaustion, poor boundaries and related nervous-system patterns. She offers clinical hypnotherapy, HypnoBreathWork and IEMT (Integral Eye Movement Technique). Based in Motueka, Tasman, New Zealand.

Contact: info@lilyalan.com
